Actual print mass depends on material and toolpaths; this is not a structural load rating.

measurements.scope: Exact CAD section geometry of the marked clamp-to-frame root. Area and centroidal second moments of area are geometric quantities only. Whole-system stiffness, material strength, FEA, physical load capacity, creep, fatigue and print adhesion are untested.
measurements.method: Fresh build123d front_frame() builds; OCC exact planar intersections and BRepGProp surface integration. All section coordinates are in the microscope world frame. The main compared sections are above the18mm clamp band, using complete connected section faces with center X<40mm and Z>12mm to exclude the remote frame. Same planes and selection are used in both versions.

coordinate_definition.dominant_bending_note: The published v3 static stage-only gravity moment about world Z is larger than that about X. Iz=integral((x−xc)^2 dA) measures the geometric width contribution at these Y sections; an increase does not imply the same increase in global stiffness or strength.

marked_connection_severance_test.note: A thin cut through the selected root separates the clamp from the mechanism; this verifies that the measured root is a connecting material path.

below_band_regional_sections.note: Window-limited intersection through the clamp/bolt region; not a minimum neck search or complete clamp section.

measurements.print_orientation_note: The v3 printable plate places original +Z toward the bed; broad X/Y saddle dimensions therefore lie in the layer plane. This is an orientation observation, not a validation of a v4 print profile or print strength.
limitations: No structural load rating or validated safety factor.
Controller, heatsink and cable mass is unknown; the published reference gravity estimate excluded these.
Section measurements do not measure clamp slip, bolt preload, barrel damage, layer adhesion, creep or dynamic forces.
